title: IQARIS-Explorer: a toolkit to explore, visualize, and export the IQARIS database
description:
IQARIS-Explorer is an open-source Python toolkit, with a command-line interface and a scriptable API, to explore, visualize, and export the IQARIS database of real-space quantum-chemical properties (QTAIM and IQA) for machine learning and analysis. The database itself is distributed separately on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22177220).

Version 0.2.0 adds the localization-delocalization matrix (LDM) and the IQA energy matrix, assembled on demand atom-resolved or condensed over user-defined fragments, with heatmap images and an interactive 3D matrix-row view in both viewers.
